text:
Take this POKéDEX, too. It records
the POKéMON you see and catch.\pHOENN's weather has been strange.
POKéMON are appearing in places\lwe've never seen them before.\pEven LEGENDARY POKéMON, once known
only through stories, are being\lsighted along our routes!\pAre they following the weather,
or is something drawing them here?\lYour discoveries could help us learn.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OpeningSendoff
text:
Head west from OLDALE along
ROUTE 102 to PETALBURG CITY.\pYour dad runs the GYM there.
Go show him your team!\pRead the route signs as you go.
They list local POKéMON by grass,\lwater, and fishing method.\pKeep reading past the fishing
lists for local LEGENDARIES. Many\lcan be found in the wild!\pFor more leads, ask the local
guide near the PC in each\lPOKéMON CENTER.\pHe can tell you which LEGENDARIES
are nearby and who to talk to\labout them. Enjoy the journey!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
text:
Whew... Thank you for helping me!\pThese papers track the strange
weather and LEGENDARY sightings.\lDEVON is studying the connection.\pOur field notes help keep the
route signs up to date. Some\ldiscoveries need more than luck.\pA sign lists any special
requirements. Once you catch a\llocal legend, it marks it Caught.\pThat POKéMON stops appearing, so
you can search for your next find.\pI must get these reports to DEVON.
First, take this GREAT BALL\las my thanks!$
